title: Bottom derived unit through good lower truncation
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories with derived categories, and assume C has enough injectives and K-injective resolutions. Let F:C→D be additive and preserve finite limits, I an arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complex, and n∈ℤ. Put J=F(I), H=H^n on D(D), and let e:H^n(J)≅H(Q_h(PJ)) be the inverse homotopy and derived homology factor comparisons. Let U be the right-derived unit at PI and let q=RF(s_I p_I), where s_I:Q_h(PI)≅QI is the quotient factor isomorphism and p_I:QI→tauGE n QI is the truncation projection. There exists d:H^n(F(truncGE n I))≅H(RF(tauGE n QI)) such that e H(U) H(q)=H^n(F(I.πTruncGE n)) d. This is a derived-unit and localization compatibility, with no cycle map or homology quotient in its statement.

source.place: Tag 05TC (2); Tags 015A, 05TH, 05TI; derived-unit naturality and truncation uniqueness, expanded from steps 1 and 2 of the parent.

proof.text: Use t.descTruncGE on Q(I.πTruncGE n) to construct b: tauGE n QI → Q(truncGE n I). Its composite with the truncation projection equals Q(I.πTruncGE n). Test b on every homology degree. For i≥n, both projections induce isomorphisms, using isIso_homologyFunctor_map_truncGEπ_app and CochainComplex.quasiIsoAt_πTruncGE, so H^i(b) is invertible by cancellation. For i<n, both objects have zero homology. DerivedCategory.isIso_iff makes b invertible. Compose its inverse with quotientCompQhIso at truncGE n I, and use naturality of that comparison to get the commuting projection equality. This is the private helper lowerTruncationLocalization.

For a complex K strictly zero below n, every left homology datum of its degree-n short complex is preserved by F: the outgoing kernel is preserved by finite-limit preservation, and the incoming differential and hence its induced boundary map are zero, whose cokernel is preserved. This is preservesBottomHomology. Choose K → L via Mathlib CochainComplex.Plus.modelCategoryQuillen.exists_quasiIso_injective, with L strictly zero below the same n and all terms injective. By [lem-weil-pbc-bounded-below-injectives-kinjective], L is K-injective, so the actual derived unit at PL is invertible. ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality and the original quasi-isomorphism show H^n(F(K → L)) is invertible. Localization shows Qh(P(K → L)) is invertible. Naturality of the actual right-derived unit therefore proves H^n of its component at PK invertible, by cancellation. This is isIsoBottomUnit, with no single-object, negative-vanishing, shift, or plus-compatibility argument.

Put K=truncGE n I. Define d as the inverse homotopy and derived homology factor comparisons for F(K), followed by the isomorphism H^n of the actual derived unit at PK and H^n RF of the localization isomorphism of step 1. Naturality of both homology factor comparisons at F(I → K) and naturality of the actual derived unit at P(I → K), then the projection equality from step 1, prove the required equation by functoriality and associativity. All helper lemmas are proved privately in the same module, and the statement remains unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_lower_truncation_unit_bridge
    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v'} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} D]
    [EnoughInjectives C] [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions C]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    let J := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n
    let e := ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors D (.up ℤ) n).app J).symm ≪≫
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh D n).app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)).obj J)).symm
    let U := F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)).obj I)
    let q := F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
      ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso C).hom.app I ≫
        (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ n).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
    ∃ d : ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (I.truncGE n)).homology n ≅
        H.obj (F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))),
      e.hom ≫ H.map U ≫ H.map q =
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (I.πTruncGE n)) n ≫ d.hom
